programs.description: An aspiring gangster pretends to be part of a notorious gang and tries to terrorise a neighbourhood. However, unknown to him, three martial arts experts live there and are ready to take him down.
Gemini said Angel and Rich trade firearms after Angel's release from jail. However, chaos erupts when they storm a lounge and slay a munitions merchant.
Jonas Maldonado, the son of a deceased police officer, joins the team and works alongside his father's former partner. Soon, he uncovers the truth about his father's death.
Jane, an American girl travelling in Hong Kong, gets into a physical altercation with three robbers where she defends herself. A martial artist, who observes the event, trains her for a competition.
Detective John Hobbes witnesses the execution of a demonic serial killer, Edgar Reese. However, questions arise when the murders start again, eerily matching the modus operandi of Reese.
Katniss volunteers to replace her sister in a tournament that ends only when one participant remains. Pitted against contestants who have trained for this all their life, she has little to rely on.
When talented getaway driver Baby meets his dream girl, Debora, he chooses to leave his shady life behind. But when he is called in for one last heist with an unstable crew, things get dicey.

programs.showName: The Mummy: Tomb of the Dragon Emperor
programs.description: Explorer Rick O'Connell and his family face Emperor Han, an ancient Chinese ruler resurrected by a rogue military faction in China via a mystical gemstone.
Peter Parker faces Electro and his old friend who is dying and looks out for Spider-Man's blood in order to cure himself.
When terrorists suddenly invade the White House, police officer John Cale springs into action to protect his daughter and the President of the United States.
A thief with a tragic past joins a band of adventurers in attempting to retrieve a lost relic. However, their quest goes awry when they cross the wrong people.
A legendary monster named King Ghidorah awakens Rodan, as well as other titans, to destroy the world. To defeat them, the crypto-zoological organisation Monarch must rely on the almighty Godzilla.
Two former black ops operatives are required to transfer two female convicts to a prison. While on their way, unknown assailants attack them.

After corrupt cops are unable to catch his wife's killers, Stanley, an unemployed man, teams up with an old friend to avenge her death.
The host invites prominent personalities and engages them in candid conversations about their personal and professional lives.

Los Angeles denizen Louis Bloom survives by scavenging and petty theft. He stumbles into a new career as a cameraman and armed with a camcorder and police scanner begins nocturnal forays across the city in search of shocking and grisly crimes. When he catches the eye of a shopworn news director who welcomes the chance to raise her stations ratings Louis goes to increasingly greater lengths to catch the money shot.
When an ex-convict returns home to solve his sister's murder, the authority forces him to go undercover to help them bust illegal activities at a nightclub.
Dan Barnes, a former professional boxer, takes up the responsibility to coach Matthew Miller, a teenager who is repeatedly bullied by a school boxing champion and his friends.

Peter Parker's life changes when he is bitten by a genetically altered spider and gains superpowers. He uses his powers to help people and finds himself facing the Green Goblin, an evil maniac.

A supervillain plans to steal the moon, but his carefully crafted schemes are complicated when three orphaned girls enter his life. He soon finds himself challenged by a new rival in the villainous world.
When a hacker reveals the identities of Britain's undercover agents, British agent Johnny English springs back into action and must overcome the challenges of modern technology.
After their victory in the 74th Hunger Games, Katniss and Peeta must participate in the 75th Annual Hunger Games, featuring all its previous winners.

Loretta Sage, a novelist of ancient tombs and daring quests, faces real-life peril when abducted by an eccentric billionaire seeking a mythical lost city. Meanwhile, Alan, her attractive book cover model, launches a clumsy rescue attempt. Together, they navigate jungle dangers and interpersonal conflicts to unearth the fabled treasure before it vanishes forever.
When two terrorists kidnap former soldier Michael Knox's niece, he employs all of his skills to rescue her and possibly foil a plan of mass destruction as well.
